title: 第1章 宗门弃子第2章 剑冢传承
content_zh:
天风国，天门剑宗。
“今日起，剥夺叶祈安亲传弟子身份，废除修为，逐出宗门。”
“立刻执行！”
随着天门宗宗主话音落下，宗门大殿内纷纷响起讥讽，嘲笑的声音。
"该！谁让你摊上了这么一个倒霉的师父呢？"
“就是就是，有其父就有其弟子。"
“有这种背叛宗门，泄露宗门剑法的师尊，他说不定也是其他宗门的奸细。”
叶祈安听着曾经同门的谩骂和羞辱，心中冷笑不已，默默地将这份耻辱记在心头。
就在几天前，他还是天门剑宗大长老唯一的亲传弟子，更是宗内千百年来最妖孽的弟子，名扬天风国。
宗门内的弟子无不对他尊敬有加，刚刚嘲笑的几名弟子更是在他面前要夹着尾巴做人。
然而天门剑宗忌惮他师尊修为即将突破造化境，再加上他本身已经是弟子中同辈无敌。
害怕他师傅对天门剑宗造反抢夺宗主之位，便联合了其余长老和其他宗门高手以在他师尊闭关之时狠下杀手。
所幸他师尊最后成功突破，但也遭到重创。
若不是他师尊以自爆同归于尽的威胁来要求放过叶祈安。
恐怕他叶祈安现在早就是一具尸体了。
而他作为宗门内年轻一辈中最强弟子，却连与自己师尊见一面的机会都做不到，这又算得上什么名震天风国的天才呢？！
可笑我为宗门做出这么大的贡献，最后竟落得一个被自家宗门废除修为的下场，当真是滑天下之大稽！
“哈哈哈哈！！”
“哈哈.......”
“如此无情阴险的宗门，不屑与此为伍。”

“昔日对我毕恭毕敬，前仆后继的人，如今却因为我和我师尊莫须有的罪名而落井下石。”
“我叶祈安真的耻于这天门剑宗得到的剑道修为！”
天门剑宗宗主听后皱着眉头，强压着心中的怒火说道。
“大胆！看我现在就废了你的修为，让你永世都只能成为一个废人！”
“慢！”
叶祈安抬头冷笑道：“不必你们这些虚伪的人动手，这身修为……”
“还给你们便是。”
只见他全身元力疯狂逆转，大殿内充斥着无比凌厉的剑意，引得虚空都发出剑鸣的声音！
似乎剑意都在述说着不屈的意志。
这一幕让宗主亲传弟子周春秋瞳孔一震！
“这家伙……竟然比我还快领悟了剑意？”
就连坐在最上方宝座的宗主都微微侧目！
“竟然已经初步领悟了剑意…甚至隐隐要突破天元境！”
天元大陆修炼境界从低到高分别为：淬体境一至九重，地元境，天元境，元丹境，造气境，造化境，涅盘境（一至九元），生玄境，死玄境，仙台境（一至三转仙台），至尊境，大帝境。
十八岁的半步天元境！！！
此子……剑道天赋当真恐怖至极，如果任由其成长，恐怕不出十年便能威胁自己。
“咳咳！！！现在你满意了吗？”
随着叶祈安全身元力逆转，一口鲜血吐出，喷洒在地板上。
然而天门剑宗宗主双眼微眯，一道剑气横冲直撞没入叶祈安体内将他全身经脉彻底粉碎！
“啊呜哇啊啊！！！”撕心裂肺的惨叫声不绝于耳。

“扑通！”
剧烈的疼痛瞬间让失去修为的叶祈安晕厥过去，倒在血泊当中。
周春秋见状这才松了一口气，脸上重新露出嚣张的笑容，心中暗道。
content_en:
Tianfeng Kingdom, Tianmen Sword Sect.
"Starting today, Ye Qi'an will be deprived of his status as a personal disciple, his cultivation will be abolished, and he will be expelled from the sect."
"Execute immediately!"
As the Tianmen Sect leader finished speaking, sarcasm and mocking voices filled the sect hall.
"Yeah! Who made you end up with such an unlucky master?"
"That's right, like father, like disciple."
"There is such a master who betrays the sect and leaks the sect's sword skills. He might also be a spy of other sects."
Ye Qian'an sneered in his heart as he listened to the abuse and humiliation of his former classmates, silently keeping this shame in his heart.
Just a few days ago, he was the only direct disciple of the great elder of Tianmen Sword Sect. He was also the most evil disciple in the sect for thousands of years and was famous in Tianfeng Kingdom.
All the disciples in the sect respected him, and the few disciples who just laughed at him even tried to behave with their tail between their legs in front of him.
However, the Tianmen Sword Sect was afraid that his master's cultivation was about to break through to the Creation Realm, and he himself was already invincible among his disciples.
Fearing that his master would rebel against the Tianmen Sword Sect and seize the position of sect leader, he united with the other elders and other sect masters to kill his master while he was in seclusion.
Fortunately, his master finally succeeded in breaking through, but he was also severely damaged.
If it weren't for his master's request to let Ye Qian go, threatening to blow himself up and die together.
I'm afraid he, Ye Qian, is already a corpse now.
And as the strongest disciple among the younger generation in the sect, he can't even get a chance to meet his master. How can he be considered a genius with a great reputation in Tianfeng Kingdom? !
It's ridiculous that I made such a great contribution to the sect, but in the end I ended up being deprived of my cultivation by my own sect. It's really the most ridiculous thing in the world!
"Hahahaha!!"
"Haha..."
"Such a ruthless and insidious sect disdains to be associated with this person."
"The people who treated me with respect and respect in the past are now making trouble for me and my master because of unfounded crimes."
"I, Ye Qian, am really ashamed of the swordsmanship attained by this Tianmen Sword Sect!"
After hearing this, the leader of the Tianmen Sword Sect frowned and said while suppressing the anger in his heart.
"Bold! Look, I will destroy your cultivation right now and make you a useless person forever!"
"Slow down!"
Ye Qian raised his head and sneered: "You hypocritical people don't need to take action, this kind of cultivation..."
"I'll give it back to you."
I saw his whole body's energy reversed crazily, and the hall was filled with extremely fierce sword intent, causing the sound of swords to ring out in the void!
It seems that the sword spirit speaks of unyielding will.
This scene made Zhou Chunqiu, the disciple of the sect master, tremble in his pupils!
"This guy... actually understood the meaning of the sword faster than me?"
Even the sect leader sitting on the throne at the top looked slightly sideways!
"I have already initially understood the meaning of the sword... and even vaguely want to break through to the Tianyuan realm!"
The cultivation realms in Tianyuan Continent from low to high are: Body Tempering Realm 1st to 9th level, Earth Yuan Realm, Tianyuan Realm, Yuan Dan Realm, Qi Creation Realm, Creation Realm, Nirvana Realm (1st to 9th Yuan), Life Xuan Realm, Death Xuan Realm, Immortal Platform Realm (1st to 3rd Transformation Immortal Platform), Supreme Realm, and Great Emperor Realm.
Eighteen years old and half-step Tianyuan realm! ! !
This boy... his talent in swordsmanship is truly terrifying. If he is allowed to grow, he might be able to threaten him within ten years.
"Ahem!!! Are you satisfied now?"
As Ye Qi'an's body energy reversed, he spat out a mouthful of blood and sprayed it on the floor.
However, the head of the Tianmen Sword Sect narrowed his eyes slightly, and a sword energy rushed into Ye Qian's body and completely shattered his meridians!
"Ahhhhhhhhhhh!!!" the heart-rending screams could be heard endlessly.
"Plop!"
The severe pain instantly caused Ye Qian, who had lost his cultivation, to faint and fall into a pool of blood.
Zhou Chunqiu breathed a sigh of relief when he saw this, an arrogant smile appeared on his face again, and he thought to himself.
